changelog.description: Admin Calendar view for appointments — week-view grid with 64px/hour time axis, appointment blocks color-coded by status, sweep-line overlap detection, List|Calendar toggle in appointments toolbar.

Admin New Booking sheet — client search (existing customers) or new client entry, service accordion picker, staff grid with status dots, date input + time select, status toggle, notes, live summary pill.

Social Feed admin page under Marketing sidebar group — grid preview matching landing page layout, add/edit post sheet (image URL, type, caption, hashtag, gradient fallback, visibility toggle), table management view, add slot in grid.

View panels for appointments, products, and staff — slide-over sheets with full details, action buttons, activity timelines, and cross-entity links (staff view shows recent appointments; product view links into edit sheet).
Add/Edit Product slide-over panel — name, category toggle, price, stock count, auto-derived status with manual override, description, gradient picker, and read-only sales stats in edit mode.
Add Staff slide-over panel — name, role (with autocomplete suggestions), email, phone, status picker, specialty tag input, and gradient avatar preview.
Admin dashboard font overhaul — Plus Jakarta Sans throughout, improved text contrast and hierarchy, removed decorative styling from all admin pages.
Admin dashboard UI — overview, appointments, customers, products, staff pages with SVG revenue chart and dummy data.
Initial customer-facing UI — homepage, services, booking wizard, shop. All dummy data. Dark luxury aesthetic (Noir Élégance).
